claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.detect.property = hostile_creature with nearest-direction readout
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family and charge-pool shell fit, but the current detect shape only models sensing the presence of a closed property within a radius. This item reports the direction of the nearest hostile creature, not mere presence, and keys the scan to hostility.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: For 1 minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.target_stops_holding_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's timed effect has a deterministic early-end condition tied to ceasing to hold the item. Current duration early-end triggers do not cover equipment-state termination.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.
